8.3.57 EthSwt_GetRxMgmtObject
[SWS_EthSwt_91038] Definition of API function EthSwt_GetRxMgmtObject ⌈
Service Name
EthSwt_GetRxMgmtObject
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthSwt_GetRxMgmtObject (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
const Eth_DataType* DataPtr,
EthSwt_MgmtObjectType** MgmtObjectPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x47
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
CtrlIdx
Index of an Ethernet Interface controller
Parameters (in)
DataPtr
Ethernet data pointer
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
MgmtObjectPtr
Pointer to the management object.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: success
E_NOT_OK: management object could not be obtained
Description
Obtains the MgmtObject of the (in this context) unique DataPtr.
Available via
EthSwt.h
⌋
